text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
All right, summer's almost over! Who's it gonna be?
Who's gonna stand in my way this autumn?
Sakura Bakushin O and North Flight. The sprint world, where ultra-high-speed Umamusume clash for supremacy.
However, the one who barged in with furious momentum was—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Buooonooo!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono claims 2 consecutive wins!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono claims 3 consecutive wins!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Hishi Akebono claims 4 consecutive wins!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Eeeeh, four wins just in the summer~ !?

No exaggeration whatsoever, it was the real deal.
In just two months, four races and four wins...

It was an unexpected breakthrough.
Going straight from maiden to...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan! Once we get back to Tracen Academy, will you do a mock race with me?"

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I wanna see how far I can run now☆"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course!
For you, Bono, I'd gladly spar anytime!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Doryaaaaaaah!!!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOO!?

I was nearly blown away trying to serve as her sparring partner.
There is no longer any doubt about her ability.

Hishi Akebono is reaching GⅠ caliber.
She was a fine contender to become the yokozuna of the short-distance division.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Uuuugh, Biko-chan... With this... With this much effort, we can finally say it...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeah...
What is it, Bono!?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hear ye, hear yeee!!
This autumn, I willlllllll!!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "I wanna be Biko-chan's riiival!!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Whoa!? That's an all-out
Big Voice attack...!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Until now... I could never bring myself to say it. Even with my big body, I never caught Biko-chan's eye at all.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Now, I can stand proudly before you like a giant wall!
Come clash with me full force at the Sprinters Stakes, Biko-chan!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course.
I'll take you on, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: But I see... So that's how it was.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: The final boss standing before me in the series finale... is definitely gonna be you, Bono!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: Yeah... Yeah... I'll show everyone I can be the boss of the Knead-Knead Gang. So—

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text: "Biko-chan, let's duel☆ Ready?"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Yeah! It turns out the guy who was with them from the very start was the final boss, and they have their final battle with him!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"This is a classic superhero trope too!
Alright, I won't lose!!"

An entirely unexpected, meteoric rise.
Leaping forward as the ultimate boss is Hishi Akebono.
A mismatched showdown between best friends awaits this autumn.
